content:
Although Claude using a computer on the desktop is not a new feature, the ability to run it in the background is indeed a welcome upgrade.

Anthropic announced today that the background computer use feature for Claude Code is now available, currently limited to macOS and for Pro and Max users.

OpenAI's Codex (now integrated into ChatGPT) was earlier this year the first to introduce background computer use for Mac. It is great to see Anthropic's Claude Mac app improve their version.

The practical value of AI-driven computer use takes a big hit when it requires you to hand over mouse control to an agent. But when it can run in the background, it significantly boosts multitasking capabilities on Mac.

Learn more about computer use features for Claude on Code and Cowork.
